what_it_enables: Tri-Vital Model: Health Points (HP), Magic Points (MP), and Tactical Points (TP)
Hex-Base Attribute Continuum: ATK (Might), DEF (Bastion Poise), MATK (Resonance), MDEF (Astral Warding), AGI (Celerity), LUK (Fortune)
Overworld-to-battle state transitions via TP expenditure (Ambush, Pinning, Celerity)
Deterministic 4-posture combat stance finite state machine
Diegetic twin relics (Shield of Lux, Sword of Tenebris) and inventory specs
Branching 5-route campaign morality resolution and dispatch routing
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across all mechanics (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
Moral sway continuum strictly bounded within [-100, +100]
Twin Relic resonance strictly clamped within [0, 100] (MAX_RESONANCE)
Tactical Points (TP) non-negative, conserved across overworld and battle
